The citations fan out of the Sources slot, and the literature and guidelines cards lift. Faceless clinician figures light past Half and a decision-support tag pins to the bar. 'UTMB's own report' pins to the bar. Accuracy and Patient care tags clip onto the answer, and a close shows them reading 'Not in release'. The evaluating-use tag drops onto the bar, and the film closes on the answer beside the chart.
